title: The Church
definition: The Church is the people of God redeemed by Jesus Christ and united by the Holy Spirit.
summary: The Church includes all true believers who belong to Christ. It is expressed visibly through local gatherings of worship, teaching, fellowship, service, and mission.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the Head of the Church. The Church belongs to Him, exists for Him, and carries out His mission in the world.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Church includes all true believers who belong to Christ. It is expressed visibly through local gatherings of worship, teaching, fellowship, service, and mission.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
